setup.command:
set -euo pipefail
if ! command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    exit 3
fi
head_commit=$(git rev-parse --verify 'HEAD^{commit}')
worktree_hash=$(
    git diff --binary --full-index --no-ext-diff --no-textconv HEAD -- |
        git hash-object --stdin
)
status_hash=$(
    git status --porcelain=v1 -z --untracked-files=all |
        git hash-object --stdin
)
index_hash=$(
    git ls-files --stage -z |
        git hash-object --stdin
)
printf 'head_commit	%s
' "$head_commit"
printf 'worktree_hash	%s
' "$worktree_hash"
printf 'status_hash	%s
' "$status_hash"
printf 'index_hash	%s
' "$index_hash"

command.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import json

with open('/app/install/data/defaults.json', 'r') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# Add systemTags with empty array
data['systemTags'] = []

with open('/app/install/data/defaults.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(data, f, indent=4)

print("Added systemTags to defaults.json")
EOF

cat << 'PYTHONEOF' > /app/fix_imports.py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
filepath = '/app/src/topics/tags.js'
with open(filepath, 'r') as f:
    lines = f.readlines()

# Find the line containing "const cache = require('../cache');"
for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    if "const cache = require('../cache');" in line:
        # Insert after this line
        insert_at = i + 1
        new_lines = [
            "const user = require('../user');\n",
            "const privileges = require('../privileges');\n",
        ]
        lines[insert_at:insert_at] = new_lines
        print(f"Inserted imports after line {i+1}")
        break

with open(filepath, 'w') as f:
    f.writelines(lines)
print("Imports added to topics/tags.js")
PYTHONEOF
python3 /app/fix_imports.py

cat << 'PYTHONEOF' > /app/fix_socket_import.py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
filepath = '/app/src/socket.io/topics/tags.js'
with open(filepath, 'r') as f:
    lines = f.readlines()

for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    if "const utils = require('../../utils');" in line:
        insert_at = i + 1
        lines.insert(insert_at, "const meta = require('../../meta');\n")
        print(f"Inserted meta import after line {i+1}")
        break

with open(filepath, 'w') as f:
    f.writelines(lines)
print("Meta import added to socket.io/topics/tags.js")
PYTHONEOF
python3 /app/fix_socket_import.py

cat << 'EOF' > /app/verify_changes.sh
#!/bin/bash
echo "=== Verification of Changes ==="
echo ""
echo "1. defaults.json systemTags field:"
grep -A2 '"systemTags"' /app/install/data/defaults.json
echo ""
echo "2. topics/tags.js imports:"
grep -E "const (user|privileges) = require" /app/src/topics/tags.js
echo ""
echo "3. topics/tags.js validateTags signature and system tag check:"
sed -n '65,90p' /app/src/topics/tags.js | head -6
echo ""
echo "4. topics/create.js validateTags call:"
grep "validateTags" /app/src/topics/create.js
echo ""
echo "5. posts/edit.js validateTags call:"
grep "validateTags" /app/src/posts/edit.js
echo ""
echo "6. controllers/write/topics.js addTags function:"
sed -n '95,107p' /app/src/controllers/write/topics.js | head -13
echo ""
echo "7. socket.io/topics/tags.js meta import:"
grep "const meta" /app/src/socket.io/topics/tags.js
echo ""
echo "8. socket.io/topics/tags.js isTagAllowed system tag check:"
sed -n '20,35p' /app/src/socket.io/topics/tags.js | head -12
EOF
bash /app/verify_changes.sh

node --check /app/src/topics/tags.js && node --check /app/src/topics/create.js && node --check /app/src/posts/edit.js && node --check /app/src/controllers/write/topics.js && node --check /app/src/socket.io/topics/tags.js && echo "Syntax check passed"
